criterion: With one test-created Surveyor layer already loaded, a settled GIS map visibly shows that layer in the Map layers list or legend, and the visible list and layer identity are recorded before opening a second Surveyor layer configuration.
steps_taken: Navigate to launcher and verify visible launcher
Open GIS and wait for map
Open first Surveyor configuration
Add first Surveyor layer with defaults
Record Map layers: Surveyor - Service only; Surveyor catalogue count 1 and matching legend are visible before any second configuration
Cleanup: remove test-created layer; Map layers panel disappears
reason: Settled GIS shows one test-created default Surveyor - Service layer in Map layers and legend. Cleanup removed the created layer and visibly returned to no Map layers entries.

criterion: Opening Add layer for Surveyor a second time displays identifiable Surveyor configuration controls and a Cancel action while the original layer remains visibly loaded.
steps_taken: Navigate to launcher and verify visible launcher
Open GIS
Open first Surveyor configuration
Add first Surveyor layer with defaults
Open second Surveyor Add layer configuration without adding it
Observe Surveyor controls: Active layer Service, Date range Last 30 days, filters and Cancel; original Surveyor - Service remains behind configuration
Cleanup: Cancel configuration; remove test-created layer; Map layers panel disappears in current page
reason: Second Surveyor configuration displays identifiable controls and Cancel while original Surveyor - Service remains visible. Cleanup removed the created layer in the current page, but one Surveyor - Service was present on the next criterion's fresh GIS navigation; persistence/origin of that entry is not established. It was retained as an existing entry in subsequent criteria.

criterion: After selecting Cancel in the second Surveyor configuration, the configuration closes and the map returns with a visible Map layers list containing the same entries as the recorded pre-configuration list; no additional Surveyor layer is present and the original layer remains present.
steps_taken: Navigate to exactly https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher and verify visible launcher
Open GIS and wait for map to settle; observe one existing Surveyor - Service entry, preserve it
Open Surveyor configuration and add one default Surveyor - Service layer; new layer is second Map layers entry
Record separate baseline Map layers list [Surveyor - Service, Surveyor - Service] in that order and catalogue count 2
Open next Surveyor Add layer configuration; observe Active layer Service, Last 30 days and Cancel; do not press Add layer
Select Cancel and verify configuration closed; settled map has identical two-entry list and catalogue count 2
Capture decisive final state and read current browser URL
Cleanup: remove only newly added second entry; verify single existing entry remains
reason: Independent baseline has two Surveyor - Service entries (one existing and one added for this criterion). Cancel leaves the same entries, including the test-created second entry, and count 2. Cleanup removed only the newly added second entry and visibly restored the existing single-entry baseline.

criterion: After cancelling the second Surveyor configuration, Display Settings can be opened for the original layer and Show linked sites visibly has the same state as its separately recorded pre-cancellation baseline.
steps_taken: Navigate to launcher and verify visible launcher
Open GIS
Open first test-created Surveyor configuration preserving existing layer
Add own default Surveyor layer as second Map layers entry
Open Display Settings for newly added Surveyor layer
Record Show linked sites checked; close baseline Display Settings with Escape without changing it
Open next Surveyor configuration without adding layer
Cancel second test configuration
Reopen Display Settings for original test-created layer
Compare own baseline and final: Show linked sites checked both before and after cancellation; Display Settings reopened
Cleanup: close Display Settings with Escape; remove only newly added second entry; verify single existing entry remains
reason: Show linked sites is checked in separately recorded baseline and reopened Display Settings after cancellation. No settings changed; pre-existing first layer preserved. Cleanup closed Display Settings and removed only newly added second entry; existing single-entry baseline retained.
